description: Land Acquisition - Palugahakella and Kenawa and Dunukeiyawa, Kotawehera D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, providing detailed descriptions of specific land lots to be acquired by the government for public purposes. It includes lot numbers, land names, owners, extents, and boundaries, but does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories. The content fits perfectly within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related matters.
